name: Auranet Page and Theme Builder
author: Auranet Informática

sections.description:
Auranet Page and Theme Builder (Aura Builder) is a free visual builder for WordPress by Auranet.

Build landing pages, corporate sites, blogs and storefronts with a canvas editor that feels familiar if you have used modern page builders — without locking features behind a paid plan on WordPress.org.

All features in this plugin are free and fully functional. Nothing is locked behind a license key.

Optional support: Donate via PayPal (auranet@auranet.com.br). Donations never unlock or lock any feature.

Visual page editor

  • Open any page or post with Edit with Aura Builder (Pages list, block editor button, or Auranet Builder menu)
  • Canvas editing with sections, containers, columns and nested layouts
  • Live structure panel (layers) to select, reorder and nest widgets
  • Properties panel for content, style, typography, background, border, shadow and spacing
  • Responsive controls for desktop, tablet and mobile (preview + generated CSS)
  • Undo-friendly workflow: document JSON is the source of truth (not the DOM)

Theme Builder

  • Visual Header and Footer templates for the whole site
  • Single post template for blog/article layout
  • Sticky / transparent header options where supported
  • Appearance menu: Editar (Aura) entry to jump into the builder (when a home page is set, Site Editor redirects to Aura)

Layout and styling

  • Sections: full width or boxed, background color / image / multi-stop gradient
  • Containers: flex/grid-style alignment, gap, width and max-width
  • Spacing: independent top / right / bottom / left margin and padding
  • Typography: font family, size, weight, line height, letter spacing, alignment, colors
  • Borders, radius, box shadow, opacity
  • Image focal point (object-position) for covers and media widgets
  • Width 100% and full-width sections without leftover max-width blocking expand

Widgets and content (examples)

Structure: Section, Container, Spacer, Divider, Menu Anchor

Basic content: Heading, Text, Button, Icon, Icon List, Icon Box, Info Box, Alert, HTML, Shortcode, Embed

Media: Image, Image Box, Image Overlay, Image Float, Gallery (slider + autoplay), Carousel, Video, Maps (optional Google Maps embed)

Interactive: Accordion, Advanced Accordion, Tabs, Toggle, Popup, Progress Bar, Counter, Star Rating, Text Animation, Text Path

Social / marketing: Social Icons, Social Bar, Testimonial, Creative Cards, Preview Card

Dynamic / WordPress: Nav Menu, Loop Grid (posts), Dynamic fields, Page Content, Sidebar, Comments Form

Template library

  • Ready-made kits (business, school, restaurant, real estate, portfolio, news, landing, blog…)
  • Headers, footers, heroes, feature grids and CTA sections
  • Design systems (colors / typography presets) you can apply and then fully customize
  • Everything remains editable in the visual editor after import

Site tools

  • Construction mode: elegant “coming soon” page for visitors while the logged-in team keeps editing
  • Site globals: shared colors and chrome options
  • Optional public footer credit “Powered by Auranet Builder” — opt-in in Settings (off by default on WordPress.org)

How to open the editor

  1. Auranet Builder in the admin menu → Pages → Open in Builder
  2. On Pages / Posts list: hover a row → Edit with Aura Builder
  3. In the block editor: blue button Edit with Aura Builder in the header
  4. Appearance → Editar (Aura) (Theme Builder / home entry)

Privacy / external services

Default widgets use local/empty placeholders. The optional Google Maps widget embeds maps.google.com only when you place it and set an address (address text is sent as a query parameter on page view). See FAQ and the External services notes below.

Languages

  • Interface translations: Portuguese (Brazil), English, Spanish (shipped / community)
  • This WordPress.org listing text is authored in English; Portuguese and Spanish listing translations are provided for translate.wordpress.org and Auranet docs
sections.installation:
1. Install via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin (ZIP) or search for Auranet Page and Theme Builder.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Auranet Builder in the admin menu (or use Edit with Aura Builder on any page).
  4. Optional: Auranet Builder → Settings for construction mode, footer credit and donation link.
  5. Optional: Appearance → Editar (Aura) or Theme Builder for header/footer.
sections.faq:
Is everything free?

Yes. All features included in this plugin are free and fully functional on WordPress.org.

Do I need a license key?

No. A license key is not required for any feature distributed on WordPress.org.

Where is the “Edit with Aura Builder” button?

  • Pages list: hover the page title → Edit with Aura Builder
  • Block editor: primary button in the top bar
  • Menu: Auranet Builder
  • Appearance: Editar (Aura)

Can I edit header and footer?

Yes. Use Auranet Builder → Theme Builder (Header / Footer / Single) or Appearance → Editar (Aura) when a builder home page is configured.

How can I support the project?

Optional donations via PayPal (auranet@auranet.com.br). Use the Donate button on this page or the Settings screen. Donations do not change features.

Does the plugin load remote assets?

By default, no remote CDNs are required. The optional Google Maps widget embeds Google Maps when used.

External services (Google Maps)

  • Service: Google Maps Embed (https://maps.google.com/…)
  • Data sent: the address string you configured
  • When: when a visitor loads a page that contains the Maps widget
  • Google Terms · Google Privacy
